entries.title: Psalms 50:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> The mighty God, [even] the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof. {of...: or, for Asaph}

entries.title: Psalms 50:2
segments: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

entries.title: Psalms 50:3
segments: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

words.text: him, and it shall be very

entries.title: Psalms 50:4
segments: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

entries.title: Psalms 50:5
segments: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

words.text: together unto me; those that have made

entries.title: Psalms 50:6
segments: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God [is] judge himself. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 50:7
segments: ¶Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I [am] God, [even] thy God.

entries.title: Psalms 50:8
segments: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, [to have been] continually before me.

entries.title: Psalms 50:9
segments: I will take no bullock out of thy house, [nor] he goats out of thy folds.

entries.title: Psalms 50:10
segments: For every beast of the forest [is] mine, [and] the cattle upon a thousand hills.

entries.title: Psalms 50:11
segments: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field [are] mine. {mine: Heb. with me}

entries.title: Psalms 50:12
segments: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world [is] mine, and the fulness thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 50:13
segments: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

entries.title: Psalms 50:14
segments: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

entries.title: Psalms 50:15
segments: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

entries.title: Psalms 50:16
segments: ¶But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or [that] thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

words.text: , What hast thou to do to declare

entries.title: Psalms 50:17
segments: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

entries.title: Psalms 50:18
segments: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers. {hast...: Heb. thy portion was with}

words.text: with him, and hast been partaker

entries.title: Psalms 50:19
segments: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit. {givest: Heb. sendest}

entries.title: Psalms 50:20
segments: Thou sittest [and] speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.

entries.title: Psalms 50:21
segments: These [things] hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether [such an one] as thyself: [but] I will reprove thee, and set [them] in order before thine eyes.

words.text: [such an one] as thyself: [but] I will reprove

entries.title: Psalms 50:22
segments: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear [you] in pieces, and [there be] none to deliver.

entries.title: Psalms 50:23
segments: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth [his] conversation [aright] will I shew the salvation of God. {that...: Heb. that disposeth his way}

words.text: me: and to him that ordereth
